Sara Duterte’s 30 years.

🇵🇭Davao City: 35+ YEARS of non-stop Duterte family stranglehold. Debt-free 8 years running. ₱37B+ assets flex. “Safest, cleanest, most disciplined city in PH” nonstop propaganda. Reality check? According to the OFFICIAL TomTom Traffic Index 2025 released Jan 2026, based on real GPS data from devices worldwide:

Davao has the WORST TRAFFIC IN THE ENTIRE PHILIPPINES AGAIN for the second straight year. Globally? 12th WORST CITY out of 492 cities across 62 countries. Average congestion level: 66.2%. Drivers lose 168 HOURS, 7 full days and 40 minutes, stuck in rush-hour traffic EVERY YEAR, an increase from 2024. A 10km drive takes 34 minutes 17 seconds. Average speed: a laughable 17.5 km/h. Highway trip ratio: 0% with NO HIGHWAYS AT ALL. Manila? Only 57% congestion, ranks 40th globally, loses “just” 143 hours. Davao out-congests the capital it was hyped to destroy. 😂💀

Direct proof from TomTom:
Global ranking: https://t.co/DkFqzMcyz3 (Davao #12 at 66.2%)
Davao city page: https://t.co/0Pn6jKrAF0 (66.2% congestion, 168 hours lost, no highways)
PH country ranking: https://t.co/eY2h8PuRlv (Davao #1 worst in PH, Manila #2)

Check my original post roasting the horizontal sprawl disaster: https://t.co/splLS0sX1H

Endless low-density subdivisions choking every road, jeepney pandemonium, dusty diversions, flash floods in 265+ spots, drainage that functions like glorified septic tanks with no real centralized sewer, JICA desludging plant still “in planning” forever. Coastal dumps, garbage rivers, “cleanest city” trophies while begging for 5-year cleanups. COA 2024 audit calls out ₱8.2 to ₱8.7 BILLION in unreconciled “ghost assets,” shady inventories, ₱530M confidential funds, more than Metro Manila combined. Baste’s “anti-epal” EO? Pure clown makeup over the Duterte name superglued to every durian banner, “no entry” sign, and political corpse.

Sara preaches nationally: “To turn around a country, you need at least 30 years of long-term continuity.” GIRL, your bloodline already had 35+ in Davao and turned it into the Philippines’ undisputed traffic apocalypse capital. Richest spreadsheets, rankest streets, fakest flex imaginable. Drugs still pouring in, poverty glued at 10 to 15%, inequality exploding, death squad ghosts haunting every corner, and now commuters lose a full WEEK of life annually to gridlock while the dynasty pats itself on the back for being debt-free. This is the “Davao model” that was supposed to cure the nation in 2016? No wonder the whole country needs decades. Your crew spent generations planting traffic jams instead of planting progress.

PBBM gets 6 years to clean up the national dumpster fire your family co-authored. You had THREE AND A HALF DECADES of monopoly locally and delivered the WORST TRAFFIC IN PH according to TomTom’s cold, hard GPS truth. “Continuity” is not vision. It is a hereditary traffic jam with death squad exhaust as the family perfume.

If fixing a country takes 30 years, maybe finish the one city you’ve owned longer than most dictators last. Or is actual urban planning too “dilawan” for the Punisher brand?

DDS loading excuses: “Fake news! Speed limit glitch! Opposition GPS sabotage! TomTom hates strongmen!”
TomTom’s data: Does not simp for dynasties. It just counts the hours your “model” stole from real people.
